newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schering 96 staff bonuses to exceed 60mlndm.
newsitem.headline: Schering 96 staff bonuses to exceed 60mlndm.

text.p: German pharmaceutical group Schering AG said on Thursday its staff bonus payouts would exceed 60 million marks in 1996.

Staff would receive individual payments according to their division and rank while all employees would receive a bonus amounting to three quarters of their monthly salary, on top of their regular so-called "thirteenth month" payment.
Other non-performance-driven payments were also planned, Schering said in a statement.
Schering's management board chairman Giuseppe Vita on Wednesday evening told German television that the group would possibly pay a higher dividend in 1996 as profits were rising.

Vita said Schering was expecting its profit to increase by around 30 percent in 1996, with sales up around 11 percent. That could make it possible to raise its dividend to two marks per share from 1.55 marks for 1995.
